dedupe_keys.name: fixed wind kra england wales ni the crown estate

description: The Crown Estate publishes spatial outputs from Everoze’s October 2020 methodology for fixed offshore wind key resource areas. Technology groups use water depth, sediment and geological conditions with an overall minimum wind-speed criterion of 9 m/s, considering technology to a deployment date of 2040. The source excludes other seabed uses and environmental constraints from this first suitability stage. These are resource-potential screening areas, not consented or operating wind farms. Coverage is English, Welsh and Northern Irish waters. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source offers data free of charge under Crown Estate GIS terms, with attribution, distribution and resale restrictions. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the other Crown Estate wind, tidal and wave agreement layers reviewed in the Thames Estuary catalogue.
